Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You have highlighted available capacity and a continuing relationship—it sounds like a steadier workload would be valuable to you. We want to build on that partnership while making the complete kit more economical to source. How could a longer commitment translate into a meaningful bundle discount?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.88 a fair kit price. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.60. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.88 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We welcome your proposal to consolidate the kit volume and commit to a 24-month contract. Factoring in the extended term and the verified index data, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.38 per kit, representing a substantial bundle discount.

For our Angebot, we can offer a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

To help us better understand the market context you referenced, we kindly ask you to share the competing quotes for the additional component. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You welcome the consolidated kit business and extended commitment, yet return to binding volume as the route to a better price—it sounds like dependable demand is what matters most to you. We want that commitment to support a straightforward, lasting arrangement for the complete kit. How can you translate that demand certainty into a further bundle discount?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. As calculated, your own current prices give EUR 5.95 per kit; our offer reflects a fair bundle discount for a multi-year single-source agreement. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 5.03 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. We have verified the labour cost index data you cited, though its effect on our overall cost structure is minimal. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Furthermore, material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

In recognition of your improved offer and the demand certainty a 24-month commitment provides, we can reduce our price to EUR 5.24 per kit. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

To confirm the full details of our offer: we propose a price of €5.24 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
